photo.alt: South Tarawa from the air, a thin strip of land in the lagoon
photo.credit: Photo taken by Government of Kiribati employee in the course of their work, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

worth_knowing: A string of small islets joined by one main road, from Betio in the west to Bonriki and Tanaea in the northeast. It holds most of the government and more than half of Kiribati's people.
